Hi Shital and Sundar,

I thought you truly deserve a good review.

I received the fish safely, and your packaging was excellent. There was no leakage or damage, and all the fish arrived alive.

I asked my staff to keep the bags floating in my aquarium for about 30 minutes so the fish could adjust to the water temperature properly. I also asked him to send me a video after releasing the fish into the tank.

Currently, I am feeding them Hikari Gold sinking cichlid food, and I hope this will help maintain and enhance their color.

You both were very professional, extremely prompt, and I am very happy with your service and support throughout the process.

I will definitely give you a 5-star review —>  5 out of 5.

Thank you once again.
